_comment: bots-stage1 (docs/progress/bots-stage1.md): optional sidecar read by tools/server/make_base_json.py next to the map descriptor. Positions are navmesh-verified in-game (UiBridge teleports / player positions, 2026-09-19). Radii follow Factory's SpawnSphereParams (bots 25-35 m). Kept out of equator.json so the Unity editor's JsonUtility reader never sees these fields. Only the ground floor is playable on Equator; the upper rings are decoration (user, 2026-09-20), so no spawn goes above y 0.2 (the former ring2-west point at y 10.8 was a NavMesh island). bots-stage3 (2026-09-20): PMCs come from BossLocationSpawn entries (BossName pmcUSEC/pmcBEAR), not from waves — Factory ships four such entries; SPT's PmcWaveGenerator only replaces them for maps listed in pmc.json customPmcWaves, so ours survive untouched. boss_zone names the zone explicitly (BossLocationSpawn.FindZoneWithCorrectName searches every BotZone), and the bot spawns carry the BotPmc category so BotZone.HasPmcBotSpawns is true as well. Equator ArenaMode integration (2026-09-20): two additional bot points at each end preserve the 25 m Arena bot-distance floor with at least three distant candidate points (the injector requests two bots per burst). All four additions passed UiBridge NavMesh, zone, full path and standing-room checks from the atrium and Usec niche on the 10404-vertex/4572-triangle bake. South-east uses the verified snapped point (8.7, 0.1, -28.4). Four other tested candidates were rejected during independent review because they overlapped player spawn coordinates. The extra All player marker gives both PMC sides a southern entry; ArenaMode respawns use all Player markers. 2026-10-23 (user, docs/progress/equator-booth-spawns.md): the four player spawns stand on four of Arena's 20 TeamFight spawn markers (equator.modes.json spawn_markers, same coordinates) behind the booth doors: north booth All = marker 19 (-4.897, 45.44) and Usec = marker 6 (6.52, 48.589), south booth Bear = marker 15 (4.974, -39.087) and South_All = marker 12 (-4.346, -39.087), yaw 180 north and 0 south = facing the doors, each on its own half of the booth (one behind the west door pair, one behind the east pair) and 2.5 m or more outside the exit boxes. Before, the Usec point stood in the FCK hall (-11.7, 48.6), a port choice: all 20 Arena markers lie in the booths and LevelBorder (83) walls the hall off. The FCK roller shutter is a wall again (equator.json opened_barriers is empty), which cuts the hall (x -35..-10, z 34.6..49.6, 246 m2) off the NavMesh, so bot north-hall moved from (-11.5, 37.0) inside the hall to (-5.5, 0.1, 33.0) on the field (3.7 m of mesh clearance, 12.5 m from the nearest player marker). No spawn, bot spawn or exit lies in the FCK hall. 2026-10-25 (docs/progress/equator-booth-spawns.md): bot-south-west moved (-9, -28) -> (-7.5, -28.0) and bot-south-east (8.7, -28.4) -> (7.5, -29.0) because both stood on the very edge of the NavMesh (0.00 m and 0.05 m of clearance, so the placement repair had to push them in); the new points have 1.50 m and 1.27 m of clearance in the play component.
